subject: Re: Scheduling demo - timezone/DST mix-up
messages:
From: Michael Tan <michael.tan@acme-payments.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme-payments.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request - Redwood Inference (time zones?)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick response on our discovery call last week — we'd love to see a demo of the Redwood Inference platform focused on throughput and multi-region routing. I'm in Palo Alto (PDT), Sara is based in London (GMT), and a couple of our infra folks are in Singapore (SGT).

Can we aim for next Tuesday or Wednesday morning PST? I threw out 10:00am PDT / 18:00 CET as a couple of options but wanted to double-check since Sara mentioned DST changes this month. Also traveling next week so flexibility would be ideal.

Best,
Michael
Michael Tan
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Payments
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Michael Tan <michael.tan@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request - Redwood Inference (time zones?)

Hi Michael — thanks for the context.

Quick note: DST in Europe starts one week earlier than the US this year which can cause the CET/PDT offsets to shift unexpectedly. We'll make sure to propose times in multiple zones to avoid confusion.

Option A: Tue 24 Mar 2026 10:00 PDT / 18:00 CET / 01:00 SGT (next day)
Option B: Wed 25 Mar 2026 08:00 PDT / 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT

Marissa (AE) is looping in Jonas (solutions) to confirm availability; if travel makes those windows tough, let us know a couple of windows that work for you and Sara and we'll handle the calendar invite.

Attaching a short agenda so you can approve topics.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[redwood-demo-agenda.pdf]
From: Michael Tan <michael.tan@acme-payments.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme-payments.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 00:45:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Demo request - Redwood Inference (time zones?)

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the DST heads-up. Quick update: I just got travel confirmed for Tue (flying overnight), so Option A will be rough for me. Sara flagged that her calendar shows 18:00 CET as 17:00 after the EU DST change — I think that's the source of our confusion.

Would you be able to do Wed 25 Mar 08:00 PDT (16:00 CET) — that would be 23:00 SGT which is late but acceptable for our Singapore folks if they join part of the session. If that still doesn't work for your team, happy to push to later that week.

Also, can you send the invite with both CET and PDT times in the description? That helped us last time.

-Michael

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request - Redwood Inference (time zones?)

Hi all — I'm Marissa (AE) and I'll own scheduling/logistics. Jonas confirmed he can do Wed 25 Mar at 08:00 PDT. I've created a tentative Google Calendar invite and included both PDT and CET times in the description per Michael's ask.

Invite details (converted):
- Wed, 25 Mar 2026 | 08:00 - 09:00 PDT
- Wed, 25 Mar 2026 | 16:00 - 17:00 CET
- Wed, 25 Mar 2026 | 23:00 - 00:00 SGT

Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123456
Agenda: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (attached)

If travel causes any last-minute changes, flag here and we'll pivot — we can also offer a recording-only option for the Singapore team if joining live is infeasible.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Michael Tan <michael.tan@acme-payments.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 16:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Demo request - Redwood Inference (time zones?)

All good from our side — confirmed for Wed 25 Mar 08:00 PDT / 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT.

Thanks for calling out the DST mismatch — we double-checked the calendar invite and included explicit time conversions in the description to avoid auto-conversion errors. We'll run a focused 45-minute demo (throughput, routing, and fallbacks) and leave 15 minutes for questions.

See you then — calendar invite sent.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
